title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Title: Business Development Executive - Financial Services

Location: Watford, Hertfordshire

Salary: £26,500 starting salary (£27,500 after probation) + Performance Incentives, OTE £35,000-£38,000

Job Type: Permanent, Full time, Office Based

Start date: Training starts Monday 30th November 2026

Build your career in business development and financial services

Confident communicator? Commercially minded? Ready for your next career move?

If you've worked in sales, business development, account management, recruitment, customer service, retail or hospitality, you may already have the skills we're looking for.

At Fortrade, you'll join as a Business Development Executive, working with clients who have already registered and shown an interest in our services.

You'll build professional relationships, understand client needs, introduce clients to our platform and products, and identify opportunities to develop those relationships.

This is not cold calling - You will be speaking with people who have already registered and shown an interest in our services.

Key responsibilities:

A few of the main day-to-day responsibilities:
- Speaking with clients who have already registered and shown an interest in Fortrade
- Building and developing professional client relationships
- Understanding client needs and communicating our platform and services clearly
- Supporting clients through the account-opening process
- Working towards individual and team performance targets
- Receiving ongoing coaching and developing communication and product knowledge

What we're looking for

You don't need a finance degree or previous financial markets experience.

We're looking for people who are:
- Confident and professional communicators
- Commercially aware and motivated by results
- Ambitious and keen to progress
- Resilient and comfortable working towards targets
- Coachable and willing to learn
- Good at building professional relationships
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

Experience in sales, business development, recruitment, account management, customer service, retail, hospitality or financial services is welcome.

Build your career with Fortrade

This role gives you the opportunity to develop your skills within financial services and progress as your experience and performance grow.

There are opportunities to develop towards Senior Account Manager or Team Leader positions based on performance, development and business requirements.

We've seen people progress to Senior Account Manager in as little as four months.

What you'll get:
- £26,500 starting salary
- £27,500 after probation
- Performance incentives
- Earning potential of £35,000-£38,000 including base salary and performance incentives
- Fully paid training
- Ongoing coaching and development
- Annual salary increases
- Pension
- Free on-site parking
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Internal career progression opportunities

Training starts Monday 30th November 2026

Successful candidates from the initial interview stage will be invited to our one-week fully paid training programme.

You'll learn about the platform, products, communication and compliance while demonstrating your suitability for the role.

Training is part of the selection process, followed by a Final Interview.

Successful candidates will then join the team.

About Fortrade

Fortrade is a global CFD and Forex trading provider authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), FRN 609970.

The role operates in an execution-only environment and does not involve providing personal financial advice or making trading decisions for clients.

Ready for your next move?

If you're confident, ambitious and enjoy building relationships and working towards results, we'd like to hear from you.

Build your skills. Develop your career. Progress with Fortrade.

Apply now for the Business Development Executive position in Watford.

Please click on the APPLY button to send your CV and Cover Letter for this role.

Candidates with experience of: Account Manager, Business Development Manager, Client Account Manager, Customer Service Executive, Sales Account Manager, Sales Executive, Sales Consultant, Business Development Representative, Business Development Consultant, Account Executive, Client Relationship Executive, Recruitment Consultant, Recruitment Resourcer, Customer Success Executive may also be considered for this role.

title: External Engagement Officer
description:
External Engagement Officer
Salary - 32,000 depending on experience plus other Veolia benefits

Location - Wiggenhall Road, Watford, WD18 0 FB, and 210 Pentonville Road, London, N1 9 JY

Hours - 40 hours per week. Monday to Friday. 9am to 5.30pm
Your application must include a CV and a covering letter evidencing how you meet the job criteria. Applications without a CV and a covering letter will not be considered.
When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.
We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential
- Stream - Employee financial wellbeing support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & reward

What you'll be doing
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an External Engagement Officer to design and deliver strategic campaigns to support local authorities to promote recycling and waste minimisation.
As an External Engagement Officer, you will develop engaging digital social media content for local authorities in a number of formats, including video, and will have the chance to make a real impact on recycling rates by communicating with residents using innovative digital techniques. You will also lead on reactive and proactive press for your area, with the opportunity to identify and develop good news stories throughout the year.
You will support your team by communicating with residents to solve issues, including delivering face-to-face community engagement activities to achieve project goals, and responding to resident complaints on social media. This could include identifying target groups and developing appropriate strategies to deliver key messages, delivering community events, and door-knocking target areas.
You will have the experience of working in a team to deliver projects and will be confident in managing a varied workload.
You will need to be a detail oriented and creative individual who is confident in communicating concisely and clearly.
This role will involve working in both Watford and Kings Cross in a hybrid manner. Some evening and weekend work will be required on occasion and a full driving licence and experience of driving in the UK is preferable.
The experience you will need
Essential:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Understand how to utilise social media campaigns and tailor communication to different audiences
- Confident in developing content in multiple formats, and will possess filming and basic video editing skills
- Have excellent attention to detail, planning and organisational skills and a proven ability to prioritise workloads and multi-task
- Experience of complaint resolution and speaking to the public

Desirable:
- Knowledge of the recycling sector
- Experience working with local authorities
- Experience designing and delivering social media, social advertising and digital campaigns
- Experience dealing with media proactively and reactively
- Full UK Driving Licence and experience of driving in the UK

You will be able to work unsupervised when necessary but will also be happy collaborating with teammates. You will be available to work weekends and evenings occasionally as and when it is required.

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Title: Finance Assistant (4-5 Month FTC)

Location: Watford (100% office-based)

Salary: £33,000 - £37,000 (pro rata)

4-5 month fixed-term contract

Our client, a leading logistics group based in Watford, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to join their finance team on a 4-5 month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for a part-qualified or early-career finance professional to gain hands-on experience within a fast-moving, operationally focused business.

Responsibilities:
- Support the month-end close process, including posting journals and assisting with accruals and prepayments
- Assist with the preparation of management accounts and supporting schedules
- Perform balance sheet reconciliations and investigate variances
- Maintain accurate financial records, ensuring data integrity across finance systems
- Support budgeting and forecasting processes with analysis and data preparation
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable processes as required
- Liaise with operational teams to resolve finance queries and improve information flow
- Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and support to the wider finance team

Role Requirements:
- Studying towards an accounting qualification (AAT / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent) or relevant practical experience
- Previous experience in a finance assistant or accounts role
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills
- Confident Excel skills and ability to work with large volumes of data
- Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with non-finance stakeholders
- Proactive attitude with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Accounts and Billing) Location: Watford (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home)
Contract Type: Temp to Perm
Availability: Immediately available candidates only
Salary Range: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum

Role Purpose
To support the day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, customer billing, and collections. The role maintains accurate financial records, resolves routine queries, and supports the wider finance team, managing routine work independently with appropriate review and escalation of complex matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, checking that the required approvals are in place and applying accurate nominal ledger coding.
- Process employee expenses, checking coding and uploading transactions into the finance system.
- Process credit card expenses, ensuring accurate nominal coding and application of established VAT treatments.
- Record bank receipts and payments in Sage, complete bank reconciliations, and investigate or escalate outstanding differences.
- Maintain subscription billing and collection records, ensuring that direct debit mandates in GoCardless and payment arrangements in Stripe align with invoices in the relevant billing systems, including Stripe, Naviga, and Xero.
- Monitor failed customer payments and follow the agreed process to resolve collection issues.
- Allocate customer receipts from the bank account to invoices in Naviga and investigate unallocated cash.
- Reconcile billing, payment-provider, and accounting records to bank receipts, investigating missing allocations, duplicate entries, and unexplained differences.
- Manage the finance inbox, responding to and resolving routine queries and referring matters to the appropriate colleague where required.
- Prepare national statistics survey responses, coordinating review of unusual definitions or matters requiring judgement.
- Maintain clear supporting records and follow up unresolved items to completion.
- Assist the wider finance team with duties and ad hoc projects consistent with the scope of the role.

Scope and Accountability
Manage routine processing, reconciliations, and queries independently within agreed procedures and deadlines. Escalate complex accounting or VAT matters and issues requiring approval to the appropriate finance colleague.
Person Specification
Essential Experience, Knowledge, and Skills
- Relevant practical finance experience covering purchase ledger, expenses, customer receipts, and bank reconciliations, with the ability to manage routine work with normal supervision.
- Sound working knowledge of bookkeeping, including double-entry principles and the relationship between invoices, credit notes, payments, receipts, and ledger balances.
- Experience investigating reconciliation differences, payment discrepancies, and unallocated receipts, with appropriate follow-up and escalation.
- Ability to apply established nominal and VAT coding and recognise transactions requiring technical review.
- Confidence comparing and reconciling data across accounting, billing, and payment systems.
- Practical Excel skills, including filters, lookups, SUMIFS, and duplicate checks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to resolve queries with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation, and ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
- Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek approval or technical support.

Qualifications
- AAT Level 3 completed or in progress, or equivalent practical knowledge and experience.

Desirable Experience and Skills
- Experience in a subscription or recurring billing environment.
- Experience using GoCardless or Stripe for collections and reconciliation.
- Experience using Sage or Xero, and familiarity with Naviga.
- Experience working across multiple finance or billing systems and following up failed payments.
- Experience completing Office for National Statistics surveys or similar business returns.
- Ability to use Excel pivot tables.

This includes, but not limited to, Service, Invoicing, Implementation, Contracts, Incident Handling, Engineering, and Credit and Collections. - Align with Sales team on customer expectations, growth, and retention strategies. An emphasis on driving a positive experience with both new and current equipment and assisting Sales. - Collaborate with Sales team to identify upsell opportunities, and referrals while keeping customers satisfied and engaged with the current product portfolio. - Assess client needs and find creative solutions to assist and manage challenging customers requests and escalation.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

Location: Watford Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 Permanent: Office-based Monday - Friday

CTR Select is recruiting on behalf of our client for a Marketing Executive to join their team. This is a varied, commercially focused role covering digital marketing, content creation, customer engagement and sales support.

A key focus will be increasing customer adoption and use of the company's B2 B digital ordering portal, alongside delivering campaigns that support sales growth and customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop campaigns to increase customer adoption and usage of the digital ordering portal.
- Create targeted email and SMS campaigns to drive engagement and ordering frequency.
- Produce user guides, video tutorials, sales tools, pitch decks and product materials.
- Promote new digital services and portal features to existing customers.
- Create marketing materials for sales meetings, conferences and promotions.
- Manage social media content, blogs, newsletters and website updates.
- Build and distribute targeted email campaigns.
- Monitor website performance and support SEO activity.
- Track digital engagement, sales activity and campaign performance.
- Monitor competitor activity and identify marketing opportunities.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support business growth.
- Maintain brand assets, templates and marketing materials.

About You

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a marketing role, preferably within a B2 B or commercial environment.
- Experience with email marketing, CMS and CRM systems such as Salesforce.
- Experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design tools.
- Good understanding of digital marketing, social media and SEO.
- Strong Excel, organisational and analytical skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive, commercially aware and flexible approach.
- An understanding of AI tools and their application within marketing.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on, creative and commercially minded marketer looking for a varied role where they can make a real impact on customer engagement and business growth.

If this Marketing Executive role is of interest to you, please click apply or contact Marie Spratley in our Egham office.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
We are currently recruiting for an exciting opportunity as an Operations Co-Ordinator to join a growing and dynamic team based in Watford, Hertfordshire. This role offers the chance to play a key part in a thriving international business, supporting the full lifecycle of customer order fulfilment, from initial enquiries and order updates through to delivery coordination and issue resolution. The client is renowned for delivering end-to-end procurement, supply chain management, logistics and financial solutions to businesses operating across the mining and energy industries, supported by a global network of suppliers and service providers.

You will work closely with internal departments and external partners to ensure customers receive a seamless and professional service throughout the order process. Acting as a key point of contact for customers, you will provide regular updates, manage expectations and coordinate with the wider Operations, Accounts and Warehouse teams to ensure goods are delivered on time and in full. You will also liaise with third-party logistics providers to arrange transport, packaging, inspections and other services in line with customer requirements. This role is ideal for someone who is customer-focused, proactive and keen to develop within a busy international operations environment.

You will be responsible for monitoring customer orders, providing accurate updates, preparing invoices and supporting documentation, and coordinating domestic and international logistics. A key part of the role will involve investigating and resolving discrepancies raised by customers or internal teams, maintaining accurate order records and escalating issues where necessary to ensure a swift resolution. Going above and beyond for customers will be essential, so excellent communication skills, attention to detail and a professional, solutions-focused approach are paramount. Previous experience in customer service, order processing, account management or operations administration would be beneficial, while knowledge of logistics or CRM systems would be an advantage.

This is a full-time, office-based position in Watford, Hertfordshire, working Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm. The role offers a salary of 26,000 - 29,000 per annum, dependent on experience, plus a generous monthly bonus scheme following successful completion of probation. Additional benefits include 20 days' annual leave, increasing with service to 25 days, five personal days, a wellness day, your birthday off, group life assurance, a pension scheme, subsidised on-site meals, paid sick days and regular office socials. If this role sounds like something of interest, we would love to hear from you!
